lines: A Coach for Coaches: What Chuck Carswell Taught Me

Chuck Carswell has spent two decades as the heart of CrossFit's coaching education, shaping thousands of trainers with humility, patience, and an infectious laugh. This is a look at the coach behind the seminars: what makes him beloved, what makes him effective, and 10 videos and articles where you can learn from him directly. Whether you're an athlete trying to improve a little bit every day, a coach who wants to learn from the best, or just want some hard-earned wisdom to help you over your next hurdle in life, this is for you
